Punkt.et: From Middle High German punct, Late Latin pūnctus. Doublet of bunt.

pünktlich.et:
From Punkt + -lich. Further from Latin punctus (p.p.p. of pungō), whence also English point, punctual.
Compare typologically Russian то́чный (tóčnyj) (akin to то́чка (tóčka), ты́кать (týkatʹ)).

Punker.et: From Punk + -er, from English punk, analogous to Rocker.

Punsch.et: Ca. 1700, from English punch, from Hindi पाँच (pā̃c, “five”).
